inventory/on-hand-summary.description: Requires the InventorySummaryReport report privilege (Reports menu); InventoryItems access alone is not sufficient — those users look up one part with GET /api/v2/inventory/parts/{partNumber}/availability. Preferred for stock questions — do NOT dump GET /api/v2/bin-locations or inventory transactions. Aggregates BinLocations qty/cost by part (default), productCode, or glCode. Includes open JobReq demand (qtyNeededToBuy), open PO remaining (qtyOnOrder), reorder flags. Keep take ≤ 25. Prefer partNumber for a known part, or belowReorderOnly / shortAgainstDemandOnly for exception lists. Patterns from Executive Overview Inventory and Inventory Reorder Summary. Related: GET /api/v2/inventory/parts/{partNumber}/availability, GET /api/v2/job-material-availability.

job-material-availability.description: Preferred agent endpoint for 'material availability for my jobs' or 'shortages for customer X'. Do NOT call GET /api/v2/jobs with take=200 then N× /jobs/{job}/material-availability — that times out. Example: customerCode=TESCO&status=open|pastDue|inProgress&take=25&shortagesOnly=true. Related: GET /api/v2/jobs/{jobNumber}/material-availability for a single job.

jobs.description: Agent-oriented job list for questions like 'what jobs are open?' or 'where is work on the floor?'. Optional customerCode filters to one customer (always prefer this for large shops). Optional status filter: omit/blank = all OrderDet Status=Open lines (includes hold/pastDue/inProgress). Explicit values use derived jobStatus: open, closed, onHold, pastDue, inProgress, all. Pipe-separate for unions (e.g. open|pastDue|inProgress excludes on-hold-only). Do NOT use classical status[in]=... — put the pipe list in status=. Keep take small (25–50). Response includes hasMore and totalCount. Page with skip/take while hasMore is true. For material checks prefer GET /api/v2/job-material-availability (batch) instead of listing hundreds of jobs then calling per-job material-availability. Related: GET /api/v2/jobs/{jobNumber}, /cost-summary, GET /api/v2/job-exceptions, GET /api/v2/jobs/schedule-risk.

jobs/{jobNumber}/snapshot.description: One payload for a single job: status/qty/due, sell $ / dollars at risk, material shortages, hours progress + next open step, and a suggestedNextAction. Entry: Orders OR InventoryItems OR TimeTicket. cost needs Orders; materials Orders|Inventory; hours Orders|TimeTicket. accessMode=partial + sectionsOmitted when privilege is missing. Prefer this over separate /jobs/{jobNumber}, /material-availability, /hours-summary, and /cost-summary calls. Do not open a customer dossier when the user asked about one job.

jobs/wip-value-summary.description: Requires the WorkInProgressSummaryReport report privilege (Reports menu); Orders access alone is not sufficient. Open job sell-value proxy by customer or job. For true actual cost use /jobs/{jobNumber}/cost-summary (Orders privilege).

labor/hours-summary.description: Requires the TimeTrackingSummaryReport report privilege (Reports menu); TimeTicket access alone is not sufficient. Preferred for labor/performance questions — do NOT list GET /api/v2/time-ticket-details. SQL aggregates TimeTicketDet over a date window (default last 30 days, max 92). groupBy: job (default), employee, workCenter, customer, operation. Optional filters: customerCode, jobNumber, employeeCode, workCenter. Keep take ≤ 25. Hours are windowed actuals only — no estimates or variance. Do NOT compare these to a job estimate: for estimate vs actual use GET /api/v2/jobs/{jobNumber}/hours-summary (one job, by step) or GET /api/v2/jobs (many jobs, lifetime totals). Patterns from Executive Overview Performance.

me/calendar-context.description: Call once per Ally / STS session before answering "last week", "MTD", or "YTD" questions. Returns companyTimeZone / ianaTimeZone, dateFormat (display only), nowUtc, and fiscalYearBeginUtc — JobBOSS YTD is fiscal, not calendar Jan 1. Build the window yourself: convert nowUtc with ianaTimeZone to get the shop calendar date, pick the range, then send the boundaries back as UTC instants (…Z). The UTC calendar date of nowUtc is not the shop's today. No precomputed windows are returned; week start is a prompt convention, not company data.

shop/advisor-summary.description: One call for headline counts: ready-to-ship, past-due jobs, ready for OSP/raw materials, late PO releases, quote follow-ups due, ready-to-invoice — plus sample job numbers. OR privileges are an entry ticket; accessMode=partial + sectionsOmitted (and zeroed counts) mean intentional omission, not an empty shop. Each rollup section needs its own report privilege: shipments=ShipmentSummaryReport, purchasing=PurchaseOrderSummaryReport, quoting=QuoteSummaryReport; the job sections use Orders. readyForRawMaterialsCount uses open-buy demand short vs on-hand. includeSamples=true returns structured sample rows. compareTo=priorWeek|priorMonth adds prior/delta for date-anchored counts. Great Ally starting point for 'how's the shop?' then drill into specific helpers.

shop/exception-inbox.description: Cross-domain ranked exceptions (jobs, late POs, quote follow-ups). Cap take ≤ 25. Response includes hasMore/totalCount — page with skip/take while hasMore is true. OR privileges are an entry ticket; accessMode=partial + sectionsOmitted means intentional empty sections, not an empty shop. Each rollup section needs its own report privilege: purchasing=PurchaseOrderSummaryReport, quoting=QuoteSummaryReport, shipments=ShipmentSummaryReport; the job section uses Orders.
